name: web-console.continuity-integrity-audit
purpose: Run a bounded, read-only continuity inventory and classify whether Web Console needs operator reconciliation.

include_generation.description: Include the opaque inventory generation and event-content hash in evidence.

assumptions: Web Console owns local continuity truth and its typed integrity endpoint
an unavailable result is unknown and never treated as zero
event content hashes are safe evidence and contain no transcript text
invariants: only the read-only continuity integrity binding is called
the program never applies reconciliation or reads raw transcript content
output contains counts, bounded classifications, and opaque hashes only
the envelope is printed exactly once

signals.source_counts: Bounded counts for each continuity source relation.
signals.uncataloged_conversations: Message-bearing conversation projections with neither a live session row nor a continuity catalog record.
signals.orphan_total: Total orphan evidence rows across the three reported classes.
signals.classification: healthy when no uncataloged conversations or projection drift exists, degraded when message-bearing evidence lacks a catalog record, projection_drift when only rebuildable projections are stale, and unknown when the source is unavailable.
signals.next_actions: Closed operator actions derived from the classification.

outputs.evidence: Binding id, source counts, orphan counts, and opaque hashes only.
